prompt: In the style of a cinematic film still, the scene captures a lively wedding reception. On the far left stands a waiter in a black vest holding a silver tray. The cake features pink frosting and sits beside a crystal vase with red roses. A grandmother in a purple dress is sitting on a wooden chair near the right edge, smiling at a young boy in a denim jacket who is handing her a small wrapped gift. Behind them, a photographer in a gray shirt is looking at a digital camera screen. A brown dog lies on the patterned rug next to the grandmother, chewing on a rubber bone. Above the group hangs a chandelier with glowing bulbs. To the right of the groom, a bridesmaid in a yellow dress is looking at a smartphone in her hand. A man in a green tie stands behind the bridesmaid, leaning against a pillar. In the background, an older man in a tuxedo is talking to a woman in a silver sequin dress. A balloon cluster floats near the ceiling on the left side. There is no smoke in the air. There is no confetti on the floor.
